##### Project general facts

Epoque is a contemporary residential development, created around a timeless approach to modern living. Inspired by the enduring qualities of classic design, the project combines refined architecture, thoughtful composition, and understated elegance. Set within an emerging lifestyle destination, Epoque offers a balanced environment surrounded by landscaped areas, waterfront settings, crystal lagoons, and an extensive boardwalk, creating a sense of space and tranquillity while remaining connected to the city.

The development offers a considered collection of lifestyle and wellness amenities designed to support both relaxation and everyday living. Residents can enjoy a large swimming pool, dedicated kids’ pool and splash pad, landscaped areas, shaded seating spaces, residents’ lounge, gymnasium, children’s play areas, and recreational facilities including foosball and table tennis. A promenade and lagoon views further enhance the connection with the surrounding environment, while retail spaces and convenient access to key destinations add to the practicality of the development.

Epoque offers a collection of one- and two-bedroom apartments designed to feel composed, comfortable, and relevant beyond passing trends. Residences feature private balconies or terraces according to the unit layout, kitchen cabinets and countertops, fully tiled bathrooms, built-in wardrobes, double-glazed windows, central air conditioning, vanity units and mirrors, as well as fibre-optic connectivity. Some bedrooms also benefit from private bathrooms, creating an added sense of comfort and privacy. Overall, Epoque brings together timeless aesthetics, functional interiors, and a tranquil waterfront-inspired setting for contemporary urban living.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan is emerging as a dynamic hub where residences, leisure, nature and connectivity intersect, positioned near the bustling heart of the city while remaining within reach of the historic downtown core. The area enjoys immediate proximity to the iconic Dubai Mall and the celebrated Downtown district, creating effortless access to premier shopping and cultural experiences. This strategic setting invites residents to partake in a vibrant urban narrative that is still unfolding.

The neighbourhood benefits from seamless links to the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, the innovative Dubai Design District, the waterfront Dubai Creek Harbour and the renowned Meydan Racecourse, ensuring a rich tapestry of recreation and commerce. A protected wetland teeming with hundreds of wildlife species adds a rare ecological dimension to city living. Furthermore, direct routes to the international airport streamline global travel for occupants.

Natural allure permeates the surroundings, featuring an expansive central park, shimmering crystal lagoons, a scenic canal and a breezy boardwalk that weave through the community. These amenities foster an outdoor lifestyle that balances serenity with activity. As the district continues to expand with new homes, leisure venues and lifestyle concepts, it promises sustained growth and enduring appeal.
